details.groundedness_reasoning: The citations establish that the worldwide death toll surpassed 1 million and that citation [5] was published on October 2, 2020, describing the milestone as having occurred “this week.” They do not explicitly state that the milestone was reached in September 2020, and the publication date alone does not establish that month.
